rationale: C12 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Issued four days earlier, it contains an almost verbatim passage establishing the Secretary of State’s responsibility to coordinate Peace Corps activities with country development-assistance plans and AID while preserving the Peace Corps’s separate identity and unique role. The child reproduces that distinctive administrative machinery and language, along with the same legislative-transmittal and early-enactment framing. C21 supplies underlying Peace Corps functions but not the child’s distinctive coordination passage; C09 is only a broadly similar contemporaneous bill-transmittal letter.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have further requested the Secretary of State to establish arrangements to assure that Peace Corps activities are consistent and compatible with country development assistance plans.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary of State will establish arrangements to assure that Peace Corps activities are consistent and compatible with the country development assistance plans.
shared_material.explanation: Nearly verbatim and distinctive assignment of coordinating authority.

shared_material.child_excerpt: These arrangements will assure that the Peace Corps and the Agency for International Development programs are brought into dose relationship, while at the same time preserving the separate identity and unique role of the Peace Corps.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: These arrangements will assure that the Peace Corps activities and AID programs are brought into close relation and at the same time preserve the separate identity and the unique role and mission of the Peace Corps.
shared_material.explanation: The same two-part administrative design—close Peace Corps/AID coordination coupled with institutional independence—is reproduced with only minor wording changes.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Therefore, I urge the early consideration and enactment by the Congress of the proposal.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I urge the early consideration and enactment of this legislative proposal.
shared_material.explanation: The child reuses C12’s closing legislative appeal almost verbatim.
